268fb68fdc5dc142.description:
MongoDB is seeking a Senior Manager, Accounting to join the Corporate Accounting team within Controllership in Gurugram. This role will lead core corporate accounting activities, global close execution, balance-sheet integrity, reconciliations, accounting operations, and process improvement across MongoDB’s multi-entity environment.

The Senior Manager will partner closely with General Ledger, SEC Reporting, Technical Accounting, FP&A, Legal, Tax, Internal Audit, and external auditors. The role is designed for an accounting leader who can combine strong operational judgment with disciplined execution, clear communication, and a process-improvement mindset.

What you will do

Corporate accounting and global close

  • Lead and review corporate accounting activities across the monthly, quarterly, and annual close cycles
  • Own the quality and timeliness of balance-sheet reconciliations, journal entries, account analyses, flux explanations, and other close deliverables
  • Coordinate with global accounting teams to resolve variances, strengthen close procedures, and maintain consistent accounting practices across entities
  • Support consolidation activities, intercompany accounting, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, leases, and other corporate accounting areas as assigned
  • Partner with SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting to provide accurate close data, schedules, and supporting documentation for external reporting and accounting conclusions

Controls, audit, and process improvement

  • Maintain and strengthen accounting controls and support SOX activities, including control execution, evidence quality, process narratives, and remediation
  • Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external auditors during walkthroughs, quarterly reviews, annual audits, and requests related to corporate accounting processes
  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and increase automation across close and reconciliation processes
  • Help implement scalable accounting policies, procedures, and documentation as MongoDB continues to grow

Leadership and partnership

  • Lead, coach, and develop accounting professionals while setting clear expectations for quality, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Coordinate work across global accounting teams and help establish consistent processes across entities and reporting cycles
  • Translate accounting issues into clear, practical guidance for Finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Build trusted relationships across the organization and represent Controllership with sound judgment and a service-oriented approach

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including significant experience in corporate accounting, global close, or a related controllership function
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and corporate accounting processes in a public-company or similarly complex environment
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidations, intercompany activity, balance-sheet reconciliations, and close management
  • Experience working in a SOX-controlled environment and partnering with internal and external auditors
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or managing accounting professionals in a global organization
  • Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate effectively during close and reporting cycles, and make sound decisions with incomplete information
  • Experience with NetSuite, FloQast, Workiva, or similar accounting and reporting systems is preferred

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

26176f0b2bfcdc43.description: Location: Bangalore office (JP Nagar) Experience: 1 to 3 years Work pattern: Rotational shifts, six-day week Joining: Immediate requirement About the role BrainSightAI is a health-technology company. We process MRI scans from hospitals into brain network and tract results that neurosurgeons use to plan surgery. Every case passes through a fixed sequence of people: Technical Support, Connectomics Technologist, Radiologist, Product Deployment and Clinical Application Specialist. The Technical Support Engineer is the first step in that sequence. You check the data and the pipeline output before anyone else reviews it, you fix what fails, and you are the first point of contact when a hospital has a problem. A missed error at this step reaches the radiologist, and in the worst case the neurosurgeon, so accuracy and timing both matter. **What you will do** 1. Case processing and data checks * Receive incoming hospital cases and confirm the scan data is complete and usable. * Run the processing pipeline and act on the automated QA/QC result. Cases that fail come back to you for troubleshooting; cases that pass are posted to the review channel. * Support tumour segmentation when a T1c sequence is present. * After the radiologist's review, prepare the thresholding file with their changes, and apply the decision on which tracts come from the legacy pipeline and which from the current one. * Create the final result folder and hand the case on for delivery. * Record tracts and cases that fail repeatedly, so the pipeline team can investigate. 2. First and second level customer support * Answer questions and requests from hospitals and internal teams by phone, email, chat or in person. * Diagnose and resolve problems with software, data, networks and hardware at the customer site. * Guide users through troubleshooting steps such as checking connections, triggering the required commands, applying a manual bypass, reinstalling software and making results available to the customer. * Explain technical issues clearly and patiently, without jargon, including to frustrated or confused users. 3. Tickets, bugs and documentation * Create and manage support tickets so that every issue is tracked to resolution within agreed timelines. * Log, reproduce and follow up on bugs with the engineering and ML teams. * Record problems and solutions in the knowledge base, and escalate complex or unresolved issues to the right team. * Manage customer complaints and plan your workload so that no case waits without an owner. 4. Coordination and compliance * Turn comments from the neuro-anatomy reviewer and the radiologist into correct, specific actions on the case. * Follow channel and template discipline, keep file versions clear, and close the loop on every handoff. * Follow company policies and the compliance requirements that apply to us, including ISO and FDA requirements and HIPAA-level handling of patient data. * Collect customer feedback and share what you learn with the team to improve the support process. Shifts, travel and relocation * Rotational shifts as per roster. Current shifts are 4:00 AM to 12:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM, 11:00 PM - 7:00 AM and timings may change as coverage needs grow. * Six-day work week with one rotational weekly off. * Weekend and public holiday duty is shared across the team by roster, because many elective surgeries are scheduled on holidays. * Willingness to travel to hospitals when required. * Willingness to relocate to the Bangalore office. Who you are * 1 to 3 years of experience in technical support, application support or a similar role. Experience supporting hospitals, imaging or healthcare software is a strong advantage. * Bachelor's degree in biomedical engineering, computer science, electronics and communication, AI/ML, medical imaging technology or a related field. * Clear and courteous communication with customers and with colleagues. * Structured troubleshooting and problem solving, with the habit of finding the root cause. * Coding background in Python. Java is preferred. * Quick to learn and quick to implement, and comfortable working independently. * Good planning, and a high sense of responsibility and accountability for every case you touch.

Online Data Analyst -Urdu/India

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of India's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

• Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools

• Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources

• Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning

• Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations

• Be open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)

• Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Why this matters: Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information.

Why join the project:

• Fully remote flexibility: Complete work from anywhere with stable internet, structuring your schedule around academic research, consulting, or other professional commitments

• Structured onboarding: Access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment

• Direct feedback and growth: Receive performance assessments tied to quality metrics so you can refine your evaluation precision

• Intellectually rigorous work: Each evaluation requires methodical reasoning, framework interpretation, and structured discrepancy analysis.

• Responsive support team: Contact dedicated contributor operations staff for clarification on guidelines, technical issues, or administrative questions

Requirements:

• Professional fluency in English and Urdu (native or near-native proficiency required)

• Residency in India for the last 5 consecutive years

• Being open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)

• Advanced analytical thinking and methodical problem-solving ability

• Deep regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of India

• Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation and consistent framework application

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in analytical, technical, or research disciplines (strongly preferred)

• Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

Qualification path

• Complete your contributor profile and submit a brief background overview

• Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process

• Review the open-book study guide and evaluation framework (provided in your welcome materials)

• Complete an open-book qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given

• Receive your project assignment and access credentials

Please be aware that you may be required to rate tasks that relate to data from other countries or territories where the same language is spoken. 

Service Rates 

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.
